content: Hospitalized patients with diabetes who experience severe hypoglycemia are at a significantly higher risk of experiencing additional hypoglycemic episodes during their hospital stay. One study demonstrated that 84% of patients who had severe hypoglycemia, defined as a blood glucose level of less than 40 mg/dL (or less than 2.2 mmol/L), experienced a subsequent hypoglycemic episode during the same hospitalization. Another study emphasized that hypoglycemic events most frequently occur between midnight and 6:00 a.m., underscoring the critical need for careful insulin dose adjustments during this time period to prevent recurrent hypoglycemia.
